standard_prerequisites.use: N(U_m) denotes the normalization of Lemma lemma-splitting-abelian-category.

standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial identities
standard_prerequisites.use: The identity d^{m-1}_j d^m_m = d^{m-1}_{m-1} d^m_j is one of the relations of Remark remark-relations.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2294-2300): for U a simplicial object of an abelian category, d^m_m maps N(U_m) into N(U_{m-1}).

Verification (proof lines 2302-2307): for j = 0, ..., m-2 the identity d^{m-1}_j d^m_m = d^{m-1}_{m-1} d^m_j of Remark remark-relations holds; applied to x in N(U_m), the right side vanishes since d^m_j x = 0, so d^m_m x lies in every kernel defining N(U_{m-1}).
proof_roadmap: Recall the normalization as an intersection of kernels.
Apply the simplicial identity to an element of the intersection.
Conclude membership in the kernels of the lower degree.
difficulty_reason: Normalization stability (statement 2294-2300, proof 2302-2307): the proof is one named simplicial identity plus a one-line substitution; the identity is standard and cited from the in-source Remark remark-relations. H3.
